# Book Study Reading Coach Skill for Muse

A strict reading coach that walks you through books systematically instead of letting you skim. It builds an Obsidian-compatible knowledge wiki (`book-wiki/`) with chapter summaries, concepts, models, quotes, and questions; guides each chapter with Socratic pre-reading questions; tests mastery with a 4-criterion rubric (accurate, explained, applied, discriminated) — "I get it" never counts; runs spaced-repetition reviews on a 1/3/7/14/30-day schedule; and lets you query knowledge across books and compare viewpoints between them. Its iron law: understanding is proven by explanation + example + application. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: deliberately demanding — a chapter is only marked mastered after passing tests *and* a practice task, so it needs real time per chapter; and the wiki defaults to a `book-wiki/` folder in your project root. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
